The '''Impregnable''' was a fortress located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltanna]]. [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Edi Wedd]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used it as his stronghold during the [[Battle of Amaltanna/Legends|Battle of Amaltanna]], a battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] was the lone survivor of the battle, and infiltrated the fortress in a search for Wedd. Unable to enter his command chamber, she used her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to short-circuit the room's door-opening mechanism, sealing Wedd inside of his tomb.
